# `irs527_eains`

**IRS Form 8871 election authority ID numbers**

State or local election authority identification numbers (record type E) reported on IRS Form 8871 notices in PolOrgsFullData.zip.

**Coverage.** Not a range. All EAIN records present in the captured IRS Section 527 PolOrgsFullData.zip archive. *(measured 2026-11-25)*

- **Parquet file:** `irs527_eains.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `form_id_number` | `VARCHAR` | IRS Form 8871 filing identifier. |
| `eain_id` | `VARCHAR` | IRS sequence identifier for the EAIN entry within the filing. |
| `election_authority_id_number` | `VARCHAR` | Election authority identification number issued to the organization. |
| `state_issued` | `VARCHAR` | Two-letter state code issuing the election authority ID. |
| `line_number` | `BIGINT` | One-based physical line number within FullDataFile.txt. |
| `source_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 of the retained PolOrgsFullData.zip archive. |
| `source_url` | `VARCHAR` | Official IRS Section 527 fullData download URL. |
| `observed_at` | `VARCHAR` | UTC timestamp when PolOrgsFullData.zip was captured. |
